body: 2026-09-24. One provider-neutral `agx sessions move` with safety enforced centrally (same provider, different homes, running-process blockers, --dry-run, backup, rollback); providers only plan, and apply is the shared provider.ApplyMovePlan. Claude ships (file renames); Codex is refused with the reason (SQLite index, see rul_01a147bb89e370cf8b115c840e7ca568). Project memory moves only on a full move, not with --only. Released v0.2.0 (retracted) / v0.2.1.
title: AGX-005: sessions move is generic, movers per provider, Codex refused
